create_scaled_silu_activation: create a ScaledSiLU activation module that applies SiLU with a fixed scale factor of 1.679
build_swiglu_layer: build a SwiGLU or ScaledSwiGLU gated linear unit layer with configurable input and output channels
create_smooth_leaky_relu: create a SmoothLeakyReLU activation with a configurable negative slope for smooth gradient flow
build_gate_activation: build a GateActivation module that applies gating scalars to input tensors using lmax and mmax parameters
create_s2_activation: create an S2Activation or SeparableS2Activation module that applies SiLU activation on SO3 grid representations
